title: From Fourier Amplitudes to Persistence Images for Impact-Echo Defect Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.18732v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Impact-echo testing is a nondestructive testing method used to detect internal defects in concrete structures. However, boundary reflections, structured interference, and measurement noise can produce complex Fourier amplitude spectra, making defect classification difficult. We constructed a two-dimensional frequency--amplitude persistence image (FA-PI) from the Fourier amplitude spectrum. Using a fixed parameterization of exact multi-parameter persistent homology, each retained Fourier component is represented with frequency-bin location as one coordinate and amplitude as the other, and Gaussian kernels are then applied in this two-dimensional space. This construction has a direct analytical connection to the corresponding one-dimensional Gaussian-smoothed Fourier amplitude spectrum. FA-PI was evaluated on an experimental backfill-void dataset and a public bridge-deck impact-echo dataset, and compared with raw and Gaussian-smoothed Fo

translated_title: 从傅里叶振幅到持久性图像的冲击回波缺陷检测
translated_abstract: 冲击回波检测是一种用于检测混凝土结构内部缺陷的无损检测方法。然而，边界反射、结构性干扰和测量噪声会产生复杂的傅里叶振幅谱，使缺陷分类变得困难。我们从傅里叶振幅谱构建了二维的频率-振幅持久性图像（FA-PI）。利用精确多参数持续同调的固定参数化方法，每个保留的傅里叶分量以频率箱位置作为一个坐标、振幅作为另一个坐标进行表示，随后在该二维空间中应用高斯核。这种构造与相应的一维高斯平滑傅里叶振幅谱之间存在直接的分析联系。FA-PI 在一个实验性填筑体空洞数据集和一个公开的桥面板冲击回波数据集上进行了评估，并与原始的和高斯平滑的傅里叶振幅谱方法进行了比较。
tldr: 该论文提出从傅里叶振幅谱构建二维频率-振幅持久性图像（FA-PI）的新方法，利用多参数持续同调将频率与振幅信息编码，有效应对边界反射、干扰和噪声导致的复杂频谱问题，提升了冲击回波缺陷检测的分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a frequency-amplitude persistence image (FA-PI) built from Fourier amplitude spectra via exact multiparameter persistent homology, which encodes frequency and amplitude information in a 2D representation to improve impact-echo defect classification in concrete structures despite boundary reflections, structured interference, and noise.
